package.description: Realtime bird sound recognition with a web dashboard.

en-US.description: Realtime bird sound recognition with a web dashboard.
en-US.longDescription: birdnet-rs is a self-hosted, realtime soundscape analyzer that listens to a microphone around the clock, identifies bird species with the BirdNET neural network, filters false positives, stores detections in a local database, saves audio clips, and shows them live in a built-in web dashboard. Start the server executable and open the dashboard in a browser. The bundled BirdNET GLOBAL 6K v2.4 model is licensed separately by Cornell Lab under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and is downloaded automatically on first run.
en-US.name: BirdNET-RS
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's changed
- New statistics page
- New calendar page

zh-CN.description: 实时鸟类鸣声识别，附带网页仪表板。
zh-CN.longDescription: birdnet-rs 是一款可自托管的实时声景分析工具，全天候监听麦克风，使用 BirdNET 神经网络识别鸟种，过滤误报，将检测结果存入本地数据库并保存音频片段，同时在内置网页仪表板中实时展示。启动服务程序后在浏览器中打开仪表板即可使用。随附的 BirdNET GLOBAL 6K v2.4 模型由康奈尔鸟类学实验室以 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 单独授权，并会在首次运行时自动下载。
